about_the_game:
"Blood Lady: Twins" is a 3D side-scrolling action game with a film noir style. You play as a vampire lady and flexibly utilize both your vampire and human forms to engage in high-speed, life-and-death battles using blood as a resource.

In order to find your sister who has been missing for many years, you have to follow the orders of an intermediary and find your own way out in a world where humans and demons are at opposition. And at the end of this road of blood is Sister, conspiracy, or...... Hope?

This Demo contains the four basic skills of the protagonist as well as the prologue and part of the first chapter of the complete game. The Demo is expected to take 45 minutes to complete.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content that is not suitable for all age groups or is not appropriate to access during work hours: frequent violence or bloodshed, common adult content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio devices
  • Additional Notes: Supports mechanical hard disk (HDD), and recommends using solid state drive (SSD).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio devices

short_description: Vampiress: Eternal Duet is a noir-style 3D side-scrolling action game. You play as Miss Vampire who switches between vampire/human form and uses blood to fight in high-speed battles. To find your sister in this conflicted world, bloodshed is the last thing to worry about...
